snippet.title: Clairvoyage: The Lighthouse - Launch Trailer 4K
snippet.description:
press kit: https://volpesoftware.com/press-kit
press contact: niilo@volpesoftware.com

Clairvoyage: The Lighthouse is a short, singleplayer time-loop puzzle game in which you restore a lighthouse to prevent a shipwreck that has already happened. Hunted by shadows across an island, you unfold the lighthouse keeper’s tragic story and piece together a way to end the nightmare.

Features:

- Short film inspired experience desinged to be finished in one sitting.

- Pick up, carry, and manipulate objects with physics-based interaction.

- 8-minute time loop where each run reveals a little more of the island's secrets.

- Horror experience built on atmosphere, psychological dread, and a threat that hunts you in the dark.
